notes: Buildings of the webster area, one entry per roof part, with their aprons, landings and the plaza south of Blanton Hall. The JSON is written by a generator (/tmp/claude-0/p4/webster/wb_buildings/gen.py with aprons.py, scratch, not in the repository); edit the generator or edit this file by hand and say so here. Outlines: wall lines fitted to the 2017 LiDAR roof-edge returns in each building's own frame (outermost roof return and the nearest ground return beyond it, midway, but no more than 0.4 m past the roof return), corners exact right angles; inner part lines where the roof level steps (least misclassified split of the returns above and below the mid level). OSM footprints only as a start: the 2020 ortho shows the tall walls leaning north-west, so no outline is read from it. Heights NAVD88 from the LiDAR: flat tops are the deck median plus the rim. Webster Hall (frame -23.5 deg from (81.94, 376.19)): one flat block 59 x 13.6 m, its east end 8 m long and 11 m wide, deck 145.3 m over ground 135.3..136.5 m; a one-storey north wing at 139.2 m. It stands in the 2017 LiDAR, the 2020 ortho and the newer NAIP Plus mosaic; a Montclarion piece gives three storeys. Irvin D. Reid Hall (the former Science Hall; frame -23.1 deg from (83.09, 305.14)): a 4-storey block at 157.1 m with lower wings at 151.6-155.5 m, a one-storey north-west wing at 142.9 m, an east entrance canopy at 141.5 m (open) and a link south to Richardson Hall at 151.5 m that ends on the published Richardson corner tower wall (the footprint runs 0.5 m under that wall for the link's width, so the link lies inside); ground round it 136.4..138.0 m. Rooftop units on the tower (up to 161 m) are not modelled. The covered walk at 141 m between Reid Hall's south-west block and Richardson Hall (x 83..86, y 288..300) is not modelled: it stands over the published walk outside the footprint. Red Hawk Diner (axis-aligned): main block 30.4 x 8.8 m, deck 144.6 m inside a 145.3 m parapet, a lower north strip at 143.8 m and the entrance at 143.9 m; ground 140.3..140.7 m. Aprons from the 2020 ortho at 0.075 m: Webster Hall's west landing, two south landings where the roads zone's walks reach the wall, and the walk along its east end between the two roads zone pieces; the diner's brick plaza (OSM footway 313028561 runs round it), the concrete round it and in front of the diner with two planter beds. Reid Hall gets no apron: the main model's walks and courtyard stay on its west and south sides, and on its north and east sides the ortho shows only the leaning roof, shadow and lawn. Plaza between Blanton Hall and Webster Hall / Stone Street: concrete from the footprint line 1 m off Blanton's walls (footprint vertices reused) to the lawn edges, which are straight runs read on a brightness mask, east to 0.2 m into the Stone Street walk and carriageway, south to y 380.0 where the roads zone's walks start; a planted triangle (border bed, lawn inside, an oval bed of 9.8 x 3.2 m with true-arc ends) and a square bed east of the lawn, given layers above the concrete. Facade colours, window sizes and floor counts are guesses unless a source is cited. Edited by hand in the fix-up pass of 2026-11-20: only this note (the footprint now takes the ground under Reid Hall's link).
